title: Other clubs Mitchell belonged to
summary: Mitchell founded the Good Timers; Harold played picnics for them; Po' Boys and Jolly Boys.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, well that's nice, Roger. What other clubs you've been? You remember the Knight of Peter Clavers? You remember the Sanchez? What other clubs did you... Were you a member of any other clubs?
Well, I belonged to the... I made up a club over there, the Good Timers.
The Good Timers, that was like I played picnics for the Good Timers club.
Yeah, and we had the Po' Boys, the Jolly Boys. Oh boy, they have so many of them.
But the Jolly Boys are still... They're still going? Yeah. Yeah. God. But the two-row is a big shot in the Po' Boys.
See, there's something I wanted to ask and I forgot what it was.
Yeah, we put the 4th degree on ours, you see. Mason, he had 33rd degree.
